title: BaiZe workspace 设计模型资产化规格 v1
scope: asset-library-only; workflow artifact layer untouched; no approval/readiness/RBAC/audit additions; no existing data (pre-production, compatibility waived)

stakeholderAsset.identity: store-level assetId only; no slug id in content
stakeholderAsset.titleRule: title mirrors content.name: create sets title=name; PATCH name updates title
stakeholderAsset.uniqueness: within workspace, normalized = name.trim().toLowerCase(); violation on create or PATCH returns 409 name_conflict
stakeholderAsset.governance: pure asset-library operation; no approval/readiness/workflow events; audit unchanged (no stakeholderSnapshot recorded)
stakeholderAsset.migration: rewrite 0013 (not new 0019): CHECK 'actor'→'stakeholder', checksum stakeholder-kind-v1, file 0013-stakeholder-kind.ts; no existing data, demo/dev DB delete-rebuild
stakeholderAsset.labelPropagation: all layers unified to 干系人: assetKindLabel stakeholder→干系人; artifact-labels.ts actor→干系人, actors→干系人 (display label only, schema field names actors/actor unchanged)
stakeholderAsset.contextMdUpdate: Store subdomain Actor→Stakeholder(干系人); governance Actor disambiguation simplified; Reusable Asset kind list updated

columns.from_asset_id: integer not null FK→reusable_assets(id) on delete cascade
columns.to_asset_id: integer not null FK→reusable_assets(id) on delete cascade
columns.from_revision_id: integer not null FK→reusable_asset_revisions(id) on delete cascade
columns.to_revision_id: integer not null FK→reusable_asset_revisions(id) on delete cascade
columns.relationship_type: text not null (no DB CHECK, server-validated whitelist)

assetRelationsTable.uniqueConstraint: unique(from_asset_id, to_asset_id, relationship_type) — same pair+type deduped, different types coexist
assetRelationsTable.cascadeDelete: from or to asset delete cascades to edges (on delete cascade)
assetRelationsTable.edgeGranularity: dual-level: asset_id for join/cascade/enrich(floating-latest); revision_id pinned at write time for traceability

edgeTypes.contains: containment DAG: scenario→usecase, usecase→function, function→api, function→data, design→architecture; allows multiple parents (same function referenced by multiple usecases)
edgeTypes.involves: cross-cutting reference: scenario→stakeholder, usecase→stakeholder; stakeholder not in contains tree

assetRelationsTable.kindPairWhitelist: server-validated (fromKind, toKind, type) whitelist; extensible without migration; first 7 combinations: scenario→usecase/contains, usecase→function/contains, function→api/contains, function→data/contains, design→architecture/contains, scenario→stakeholder/involves, usecase→stakeholder/involves
assetRelationsTable.contentFieldDisposition: scenario content actors / usecase content actor retained as free-text (human-readable); asset_relations table stores structured references (machine-readable); R02 field-level assetId references never implemented in code, no existing data to migrate

archiveAutoPromote.trigger: same-transaction: inside executeCommandTransaction approve-packet branch, after workflow state→archived, before appendEvent, call promoteRequirementArtifacts(workflowId, ALL_KINDS)
archiveAutoPromote.consistency: strong: promote failure rolls back archive; archive failure skips promote; no outbox async (outbox only publishes SSE events, doesn't execute business logic)
archiveAutoPromote.promoteScope: all 7 kinds: design/architecture/data/api/scenario/usecase/function; analysis excluded (intermediate artifact, not an asset kind); stakeholder excluded (not promoted from artifacts, only manual create/import; upsertReusableAssetByTitle rejects stakeholder kind); kinds without approved revisions return 0
archiveAutoPromote.dedup: skip-if-already-promoted: check reusable_assets.origin_artifact_id (no-FK audit column, 0016-defined) before upsert; exists → skip that artifact (no duplicate revision); requires AssetStore.assetExistsByOriginArtifactId(workspaceId, artifactId)
archiveAutoPromote.relationBuilding: parse Artifact content to build asset_relations edges: actors/actor free-text matched by name to workspace stakeholder assets → involves edges; contains edges NOT auto-built by promote (artifact content has no cross-kind containment field; scenario→usecase containment cannot be inferred from content); contains edges only built by manual create/import relations declaration
archiveAutoPromote.idempotency: archive command idempotent (duplicate approve-packet returns idempotency_conflict, no repeat promote); same-transaction atomic, no outbox retry needed
archiveAutoPromote.manualPromoteEndpoint: retain POST /api/requirements/:id/promote for pre-archive preview/selective; archive-auto skips already-manually-promoted artifacts (dedup)
archiveAutoPromote.provenance: originApprovalId = packet_approval record id; source=workflow; origin_requirement_id/origin_artifact_id consistent with existing

export.shape: single segment: { assets: ReusableAssetDetail[], relations: [{ fromTitle, fromKind, toTitle, toKind, type }] }
export.relationsPortability: edges use title+kind not assetId — cross-workspace portable

import.body: { assets: [{ kind, title, content }], relations: [{ fromTitle, fromKind, toTitle, toKind, type }] } (relations optional)
import.remap: title mapping: build all assets first (by title+kind reuse or create), then resolve edges by title+kind lookup to new assetId, then build relations
import.batchOrder: 1. build all assets → 2. resolve edge from/to by title+kind → 3. build asset_relations (validate toAssetId existence, whitelist, self-loop, same-workspace)

create.bodyExtension: optional relations: [{ toAssetId, type }] declares outgoing edges of new asset; server resolves toAssetId→current revisionId for to_revision_id; from uses new asset's revisionId

patch.body: { name?, description? } at least one non-empty
patch.responses: 200 { revisionId, revisionNo } on success; 400 malformed_body if empty; 409 name_conflict; 404 unknown_asset if non-stakeholder or missing; no optimistic lock
patch.edgeSync: edge table not refreshed on rename — resolvedGraph enrich reads latest title dynamically (floating-latest)

delete.scan: bidirectional: select count(*) from asset_relations where from_asset_id = ? OR to_asset_id = ?; non-empty → 409 { error: asset_referenced, refs: [{ assetId, kind, title, type }] }; empty → 200 { deleted: true }
delete.cascade: asset delete cascades to asset_relations edges (on delete cascade)

enrich.detailEndpoint: GET /api/assets/:id returns resolvedGraph: { incoming: [{ fromAssetId, fromRevisionId, type, title, kind }], outgoing: [{ toAssetId, toRevisionId, type, title, kind }] }
enrich.listEndpoint: GET /api/assets?workspaceId= returns ReusableAssetSummary[] WITHOUT resolvedGraph (avoid N+1; use graph endpoint for topology)
enrich.graphEndpoint: GET /api/assets/graph?workspaceId= returns { nodes: [{ assetId, kind, title }], edges: [{ fromAssetId, toAssetId, type }] } for full workspace topology (frontend architecture rendering)

validation.error: aggregated 400 { error: invalid_relations, invalidRelations: [{ toAssetId, type, reason }] }; no partial write
validation.migration: R02 content-field assetId validation → now asset_relations write validation

dimensions.variables: create stakeholder 201+rev1; PATCH name→new rev+title sync; PATCH desc→only desc changes; PATCH name conflict→409; uniqueness trim+case-insensitive; PATCH empty body→400; PATCH non-stakeholder→404
relations write validation: toAssetId existence; (fromKind,toKind,type) whitelist; self-loop→400; cross-workspace→400; aggregated invalid_relations with all errors; no partial write
bidirectional scan: from OR to non-empty→409 asset_referenced+refs; empty→200; cascade destroys edges on asset delete
import title mapping: same title+kind reuse assetId (no definition override); new title+kind create; relations edges rebuilt by title+kind lookup; batch order assets-first-then-edges
single segment {assets, relations}; edges use title+kind not assetId; cross-workspace portable

same-transaction promote: approve-packet→archived→promote 7 kinds (analysis/stakeholder excluded); dedup skip by origin_artifact_id (no-FK audit column); involves edges auto-built from actors/actor free-text matching stakeholder by name; contains edges NOT auto-built (only manual create/import); idempotent (duplicate archive command no repeat promote); manual promote retained and deduped

contains edges: scenario→usecase/usecase→function/function→api|data/design→architecture; DAG multiple parents allowed; involves edges: scenario|usecase→stakeholder; kind-pair whitelist server-validated; resolvedGraph enrich floating-latest; GET /api/assets/graph full topology

0013 rewrite: CHECK actor→stakeholder; checksum stakeholder-kind-v1; file rename 0013-stakeholder-kind.ts; no existing data, demo/dev DB delete-rebuild; code全量改名 (reusable-asset-kind/asset-store/workflow-store/headless-runtime/operator-server/web/contract/test); CONTEXT.md术语更新; FTS no migration (no existing data)

reviewChecklist: 契约完整：R06-R09 决议逐项落入本规格
一致性：与既有 store/server/web 类型、CHECK 约束、A08 ReusableAsset 模型无冲突
无兼容层：无 actor/stakeholder 双写/别名适配；无字段引用与关系表并存
无越界：未动 artifact-content-v1.schema.json；未加 RBAC/审批/审计；归档自动 promote 不改 Workflow 治理状态机
关系类型白名单完整性：contains (5 kind-pairs) + involves (2 kind-pairs) 覆盖全部设计模型关系；DAG 多父语义正确
归档去重幂等性：origin_artifact_id 查询跳过已 promote；归档命令幂等保证不重复 promote；同事务原子无窗口期
releaseGate: 用户对《workspace 设计模型资产化规格》（评审文档）人工评审通过 = 本图终点；实现切面化落地走 BaiZe 既有实现流程
